findings.description: --output-dir argparse default is 'outputs' but requirements.md FR-002.2 specifies 'datasets/anchors/v1/'. Epic AC-3 says data stored in datasets/anchors/v1/anchor_dataset.jsonl.
findings.suggestion: Change default='outputs' to default='datasets/anchors/v1/' on line 48

findings.description: dependency_check.py crashes with ModuleNotFoundError when langgraph (or any checked module) is not installed. find_spec() call at line 167 is not wrapped in try/except.
findings.suggestion: Wrap find_spec() in try/except ModuleNotFoundError and report as 'not_installed' status

consensus.adjudication: 3/4 CONFIRM. John's rejection focused on AC scope (AC assumes deps installed), but script robustness is a separate concern. A validation tool should handle the case it's designed to detect.

findings.description: Epic mentions 4 .example.yaml files but 7 were created (backtracking, taxonomy, frontend are extras).
findings.suggestion: No action needed - extras are bonus, not defect

consensus.adjudication: 0/4 CONFIRM. All agents agree extras are bonus. Epic documented minimum scope, implementation exceeded it.

findings.description: anchor-dataset spec marked COMPLETE (43/43 tasks) but no physical dataset generated. Builder works in dry-run but was never run in production (requires API keys). Epic AC-1 is conditional.
findings.suggestion: Add clarifying note to epic: 'Tooling complete; dataset generation pending API key provisioning and inference budget'

consensus.adjudication: 1/4 CONFIRM. Code is complete and functional. Dataset generation is operational step requiring external resources. A clarifying note would be nice but is not a spec defect.
